name: Onstage

rounds.endCondition: Number of rounds equals the number of players

categories.label: Golden Blossoms per round
categories.hint: Total Golden Blossoms on Performers you earned that round; if you alone have none, take all Performers onstage (or in line if none onstage). Enter one value per round.

tiebreakers.description: Tied player with the highest card remaining in hand wins; if still tied, share the win.

endCondition.description: Play a number of rounds equal to the number of players.

notes: family: trick-taking. Each round's score = Golden Blossoms on earned Performers. A 2v2 team variant is mentioned in a summary but not in the rulebook text checked; not modelled.
